fields.reachability_status: OPEN QUESTION, not yet adjudicated. Two structurally different wiring mechanisms exist for the same nominal field: (a) inspect()'s unconditional_logits branch passes fixed_mask straight into build_inference_bundle; (b) sample()'s path derives chain_mask and threads it only into the ligand_context construction, gated behind ligand_context being non-None. Manual reading could not confirm whether chain_mask/fixed_mask actually gates WHICH residues get sampled vs held fixed during sample()'s autoregressive decode, or only affects a secondary ligand-exposure computation. inspect()'s 'conditional_logits' branch (runner.py:958+) and score()/jacobian() were not confirmed to read fixed_mask/chain_mask AT ALL in this pass (grep found exactly one 'fixed_mask=' assignment in the whole of runner.py). This is the single highest-priority item for Phase 2's differential bit-identity probe: set fixed_mask on a fixed vs varied subset of residues, sample, and check whether the 'fixed' positions actually stay literal to the input sequence in the output — the same technique F002/F003 used for multi_state_strategy.
